evidence_cutoff_source: parent window end (parent carries no cutoff field)

criteria.cash_cross_check: data/repo_daily/GC001.csv window mean (gross, not averaged in)

verdict_zh: 按 58 次尝试扣完租金，这本书比躺利息多 ￥237/年（0.024 个百分点），而它一年内 5% 概率的尾部回撤是 19.1%——超额是估计宽度的量级，不是边的量级。
caveats: the deflation is a haircut, not a posterior: the headline row is printed beside the deflated row so neither reading is hidden
cash_net_annual is one published rate carried on the placement face; a real parking programme re-quotes daily and its realised carry moves
the book is fully invested, so no idle cash earns this rate inside it -- the comparison is 'this book' vs 'the same money parked'
excess is computed on the parent's published volatility, so a regime change moves both the pay and the tail
